payload.description:
Product information:
Pattern: Solid color
Size Specifications: 1.2m flat sheet set – three-piece set (down duvet cover 150*200cm), 1.5m flat sheet set – four-piece set (down duvet cover 200*230cm), 1.8m flat sheet set – four-piece set (down duvet cover 200*230cm), 2.0m flat sheet set – four-piece set (down duvet cover 220*240cm), 1.5m fitted sheet set – four-piece set (down duvet cover 200*230cm), 1.8m fitted sheet set – four-piece set (down duvet cover 200*230cm), 1.8m fitted sheet set – oversized down duvet cover four-piece set (down duvet cover 220*240cm), 150*200cm single down duvet cover, 200*230cm single down duvet cover, 220*240cm single down duvet cover, 150*200cm single duvet cover with one pillowcase, 200*230cm single duvet cover with a pair of pillowcases, 220*240cm single duvet cover with a pair of pillowcases.
Yarn Count: 40s
Weaving Technique: Jacquard
Dyeing Process: Reactive dyeing
Fabric Density: 133x76
Function: Scald-proof, soft to the touch
Material: Cotton
Bedding Subcategory: Four-piece set
Style: Flat-style
Applicable Season: Summer
Design Style: Modern Minimalist


Packing list:
1 x Bedding Set (Specific components depend on selected size and type: Duvet Cover, Bed Sheet/Fitted Sheet, Pillowcases)
